# printgridpaper.com

> Free printable graph paper (also called grid paper or squared paper) as true-to-size vector PDFs. No sign-up, no watermark. Every sheet has a measuring bar in the bottom margin (100 mm and 4 in) so the printed scale can be checked with a ruler.

Humans use the generator on each page. Scripts and AI agents can fetch the same PDF directly from `GET /api/pdf`. It needs no key or sign-up, allows cross-origin requests, and returns the same bytes as the page's Download button.

## Get a PDF

`GET https://printgridpaper.com/api/pdf?size=1cm&paper=a4`

Returns `application/pdf`. A link to that URL is also fine to give to a person: it opens the sheet in the browser.

Examples:

- 1 cm squares on A4: https://printgridpaper.com/api/pdf?size=1cm&paper=a4
- 1/4 inch (quad ruled) on US Letter: https://printgridpaper.com/api/pdf?size=quarter-inch&paper=letter
- 5 mm squares, 10-page pad: https://printgridpaper.com/api/pdf?size=5mm&pages=10
- Custom 7 mm squares, landscape, black lines: https://printgridpaper.com/api/pdf?spacing=7&unit=mm&orientation=landscape&color=black
- Black paper with white lines: https://printgridpaper.com/api/pdf?size=1cm&background=black

## Parameters

All parameters are optional. With none, you get 5 mm squares on A4.

- `size`: a named square size. Each one also sets a default paper and heavy-line interval.
  - `2mm`: A4, heavy line every 5 squares
  - `5mm`: A4, every 5
  - `1cm`: A4, every 10
  - `10-per-inch` (1/10 inch, engineering paper): Letter, every 10
  - `eighth-inch` (1/8 inch, 8 per inch): Letter, every 8
  - `quarter-inch` (1/4 inch, quad ruled): Letter, every 4
  - `half-inch` (1/2 inch): Letter, every 2
  - `1-inch`: Letter, no heavy lines
- `spacing` + `unit`: a custom square size instead of `size` (do not send both). `unit` is `mm` (1–50, the default) or `in` (0.04–2).
- `paper`: `a4`, `letter`, `a5`, `a3`, `legal`, `tabloid`.
- `orientation`: `portrait` (default) or `landscape`.
- `major`: heavy line every N squares, 0–20. Use 0 for none.
- `color`: line colour. One of `blue` (default), `green`, `grey`, `black`, `red`, or a hex value such as `4A7FB5`.
- `background`: `white` (default), `black` (white lines) or `cream` (brown lines).
- `pages`: identical pages in one PDF, 1–25.
- `calibration`: `true` (default) prints the measuring bars; `false` gives a clean sheet with a few more rows.

Response headers `X-Grid-Columns`, `X-Grid-Rows` and `X-Square-Size-Mm` describe the sheet. Invalid input returns HTTP 400 with JSON `{"error": "...", "docs": "..."}`.

Machine-readable spec: https://printgridpaper.com/openapi.json

## Printing true to size

Tell the person to print at 100% / "Actual size", not "Fit to page". Then a ruler laid on the bottom bar should read exactly 100 mm. If it reads short, the print dialog scaled the page.

## Pages

- [Graph paper generator](https://printgridpaper.com/): every size and option in one tool
- [2 mm graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/2mm-graph-paper/)
- [5 mm graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/5mm-graph-paper/)
- [1 cm graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/1cm-graph-paper/)
- [10 squares per inch graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/10-squares-per-inch-graph-paper/)
- [1/8 inch graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/eighth-inch-graph-paper/)
- [1/4 inch graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/quarter-inch-graph-paper/)
- [1/2 inch graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/half-inch-graph-paper/)
- [1 inch graph paper](https://printgridpaper.com/1-inch-graph-paper/)
- [Graph paper sizes and types compared](https://printgridpaper.com/compare-graph-paper-sizes/)
- [Print troubleshooting](https://printgridpaper.com/print-troubleshooting/)

Grid styles: style=square (default), style=dot, style=coordinate (four quadrants).
Optional margin=0..50 (mm), weight=0.05..1 (mm). Example: /api/pdf?style=dot&size=5mm&paper=a4

Exact-count mode: mode=count&columns=20&rows=30. Counts must be integers from 2 to 200; coordinate grids require even counts. Square spacing is calculated to fit the printable area and must be at least 1 mm.

Isometric paper: style=isometric, spacing mode only. Spacing is the equilateral triangle edge length. Three line families run vertically and at +/-30 degrees; heavy-line intervals do not apply.

Hexagonal paper: style=hexagonal, spacing mode only. Spacing is the regular hexagon edge length. Flat-top hexagons share single edges; heavy-line intervals do not apply.

Optional worksheet headings: title (up to 60 printable ASCII characters) and worksheetHeader=true add a title and blank Name/Date fields. The heading reserves 22 mm above the grid without changing physical spacing.

Optional bindingMargin=0..30 adds extra blank space on the left in millimetres for hole punching. Grid, heading and measuring strips shift together; spacing mode retains physical cell sizes, while count mode recalculates spacing to fit.

Polar paper: style=polar with spacing controlling ring separation, and radials=12|24|36|72 (default 24). Rings form a circle centred in the available grid area. Exact-count mode is unavailable. PDF, SVG, PNG and print exports share the same geometry.

Logarithmic paper: style=logarithmic, logAxes=x|y|both (default y), decades=1..4 (default 2). Log positions follow log10 and major boundaries are labelled 1,10,100,etc. Spacing controls linear axes only. Requires spacing mode. All exports share the same geometry.

Independent margins: marginTop, marginBottom, marginLeft, marginRight accept 0..50 mm. Any side enables separate margins unless separateMargins=false is explicit; unspecified sides use margin (default 10 mm). Extra bindingMargin is added to the left side. Header and calibration bars respect top/bottom margins.

Custom paper: paper=custom requires paperWidth and paperHeight in mm (100..420 per side). Landscape swaps dimensions. Shared settings and saved presets keep dimensions; PDF, SVG, PNG and printing use the same custom page size.

Square cell numbers: cellNumbers=true with numberStart (default 1) and numberEnd (default 31), whole numbers 1..9999. Left-to-right then top-to-bottom, stops at available cells. Requires at least 8 mm spacing, with at most 1000 numbered cells. Browser enabling switches smaller grids to 10 mm; API callers must specify adequate spacing themselves.
